meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览并选择性合并上游 NanoClaw 更新
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要高效管理 NanoClaw 的定制安装更新，支持预览和选择性应用。
copy.tagline_en: Preview and selectively apply upstream updates to your NanoClaw install.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage updates to a customized NanoClaw installation with preview and selective cherry-pick.

howto.what: 将上游 NanoClaw 的新改动安全并入你的定制安装:先备份,再预览改动,按你选择的方式(合并或挑提交)更新,最后自动构建测试。
howto.when: 当你的 NanoClaw 定制版落后于上游、想把上游更新合并进来又不丢自己的改动时,在 Claude Code 里运行、update-nanoclaw。

say.text: 帮我更新 NanoClaw,把上游改动合进来
say.note: 开始预检并备份,随后预览改动供你选择更新方式。

say.text: 只挑某几个上游提交合并进来
say.note: 进入选择性更新,你可以指定要哪些提交。

say.text: 先看看上游改了什么,先别动代码
say.note: 仅预览改动清单,不会实际修改任何文件。

howto.what_en: Safely merge upstream NanoClaw changes into your customized install: back up first, preview changes, update via merge or cherry-pick as you choose, then run build and tests automatically.
howto.when_en: When your customized NanoClaw install is behind upstream and you want to incorporate upstream changes without losing your own modifications. Run /update-nanoclaw in Claude Code.

say_en.text: Update NanoClaw and merge in upstream changes.
say_en.note: Runs preflight, backs up, and previews changes for you to choose an update path.

say_en.text: Only cherry-pick a few upstream commits.
say_en.note: Enters selective update so you can specify which commits to pull.

say_en.text: Just show me what upstream changed, don't touch code yet.
say_en.note: Shows the preview only, makes no actual changes.
